prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
If you’re looking for a **spray tan**, **Tan Wolf** in Upper Arlington looks like a strong pick: it’s listed at **4.9 stars from 131 reviews**, including praise for a first-time client’s helpful prep advice and results. [Reviews and details](https://www.bestprosintown.com/oh/columbus/tanning/)

For **UV tanning**, consider **Palm Beach Tan**—it offers both beds and spray tans, though ratings vary by location. The Georgesville location is listed at **4.86/5 from 147 reviews**. [Location details](https://palmbeachtan.com/locations/oh/georgesville)

“Best” depends on the kind of tan and which part of Columbus is convenient for you. Keep in mind that UV tanning increases skin-cancer risk; spray tanning avoids UV exposure.
